description: Choosing Power Saver in battery settings shows 'performance mode temporarily disabled due to high operating temperature' although that is not the case.
expected_report: In Settings > Power the user picks Power Saver and a message appears that performance mode is temporarily disabled due to high temperature; performance mode can still be selected afterwards. Expected: no such message.
difficulty: The message is a short banner, wrong text rather than a broken UI.
